summary.text: Mark Ashley Price is the Republican candidate for Michigan State Senate District 3 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the August 4, 2026 Republican primary.
Price is a former member of the Highland Park school board and a former Highland Park City Charter Revision Commissioner.

paragraphs.text: Mark Ashley Price was born in Detroit, Michigan, and attended Highland Park High School.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Price said that Price's political career began in August 2006, when Price won a precinct delegate seat at age 20.

Price was appointed to the Highland Park City Charter Revision Commission in October 2016 and was elected to the Highland Park school board in November 2020, serving a term from January 1, 2021, to December 31, 2024.

Price ran for the Michigan House of Representatives in 2012, losing to Democratic incumbent Thomas Stallworth III in District 8, and was the Republican nominee for Michigan State Senate District 2 in 2014, when Democratic incumbent Bert Johnson won.
In 2022 Price won the Republican primary for Wayne County Executive and lost the general election to incumbent Warren Evans.
In the 2026 survey, Price said limiting government as much as possible is the policy area Price is most passionate about.
